observations: Three photos show a beige industrial sewing machine on a white table with a metal stand and thread stand.
The machine has a red oval logo with 'Emel' written in white on the head.
A label on the front right of the machine reads 'FM 8503'.
The machine appears used, with visible scuffs and dirt on the body and table.
A yellow pair of scissors is placed on the table next to the machine.
The table has a power switch and control panel on the left side.
The floor is black marble with white veining.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DEBISPAK' is overlaid on all photos.

claims.claim: Emel industrial sewing machine in a very good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear and dirt, but no functional test is shown. The condition is not proven by the photos alone.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine operating, including needle movement, thread tension, and motor function.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts (e.g., foot pedal, needle bar, or accessories).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the foot pedal, needle bar, and any included accessories.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues or damaged wiring.
risks.proof: Close-up of the power cord, plug, and internal wiring connections.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unsafe or requiring repair

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation.
Close-up photos of the foot pedal, needle bar, and accessories.
Close-up of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
